periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation, approximately 45 degrees toward the muzzle midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid, with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the mass of the patch extending towards the lower jawline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile at the posterior margin of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, spanning the entire shoulder and upper scapular region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature with no visible flattening at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish fur discoloration on the ventral muzzle and sub-mental region.
